story.title: How it all started
story.content:
In 2026, I realized that the humble hyperlink hadn't evolved in two decades. While the rest of the web became intelligent, responsive, and secure, links remained static strings of text. I built Dragolink to change that, single-handedly designing, developing, and deploying every aspect of the platform.

Today, a link is the most critical intersection between your brand and your audience. I believe that every click should be protected by enterprise-grade security, tracked with microscopic precision, and routed intelligently. As a solo force, I work relentlessly to ensure our infrastructure can handle millions of redirects with zero latency, bringing this vision to reality.
